goal: Establish a version-scoped Linux isolated-home contract without reading or copying Antigravity credentials.
completed: The diagnostics-only v0.1.0-rc.1 prerelease was published from merged commit 4aa3b93 with reproducible Linux artifacts.
The product owner approved a clearly labeled, version-scoped reverse-engineered isolated-home strategy for legitimate work/personal account separation.
Private APIs, OAuth implementation, token parsing/copying, keyring enumeration, and quota-driven switching remain excluded.
nextActions: Verify the synthetic isolated-process primitive and deliver ADR 0007 plus its bounded implementation for review.
decisions: Supersede ADR 0006 with ADR 0007 while leaving production profile switching disabled until the black-box evidence gate passes.
Delegate login, refresh, and model requests exclusively to the official agy process in separate project-managed homes.
openQuestions: Which minimal TTY and D-Bus environment is required for two dedicated agy 1.1.2 accounts without cross-home identity reuse?
Which secret-safe observation can confirm the expected dedicated account without retaining a full email?

notRun: No real account login or authentication-state experiment is authorized in this task.
macOS, Windows, desktop keyrings, and hosted CI are not tested.

risks: Antigravity may discover identity outside HOME/XDG roots; any reuse across clean homes must stop enablement.
The strategy is unofficial and must be reverified for every agy version change.
doNotRepeat: Do not inspect, hash, copy, diff, print, or retain credential contents or private Antigravity logs.
Do not enable real profile commands based only on discovered filenames or a single-account launch.
